title: 第9章 万里之行，遭遇

content_zh:
尽管在这个世界他只是过了启蒙期，但是因为洗髓伐脉到了第三层，体内就好像有一股风一般畅快地流动。如果是在地球，他早就打破所有的世界记录了。
两个小时后，阳顶天已经跑出了近一百多里。当然其实他速度可以更快的，但是跑得越快，体内的能量消耗得飞快，所以他必须掌握一种平衡。
十几个小时后，阳顶天已经跑出了五百多里，而且并没有感觉到多少疲倦，这个世界的武道真是太强大了，阳顶天仅仅只是过了启蒙期，就能够一天跑五百多里而不疲倦，当然他不知道这其中最大的功劳是第三层的洗髓伐脉。
但是十几个小时后，天降大雪，大风狂吹，而且是朝着阳顶天相反的方向吹，使得他寸步难行，而且耗费能量极度加速，于是他不得不在雪地上挖一个洞穴先躲起来，等待风雪的过去。
这一躲，足足躲了三天。
三天后，天气才放晴，天上一片碧蓝如同水洗，两个太阳如同璀璨宝石一般普照大地，反射在白雪上让人几乎无法睁目。
阳顶天从深深的积雪出来，幸亏他是九阳之躯，否则此时只怕已经被大雪掩埋了十几米了让他窒息而死了。
说来也真是奇怪，洗髓伐脉后，阳顶天呼吸所需要的氧气竟然少了很多很多，他可以屏住呼吸近二十分钟，少量的氧气就可以让他生存很久。
好不容易等到天晴，阳顶天快速地朝东边奔跑，而且是闭着眼睛奔跑，因为这里一片雪白太刺目了，而且这里万里想雪原不担心奔跑会撞上任何东西。
阳顶天运气不错，这一次足足晴了三天。
这三天内，阳顶天阳顶天足足跑了一千多里。但是三天后大学大风又来了，于是阳顶天不得不再次挖个洞穴躲起来。
这一躲，足足躲了七天，这次的大风大雪比上一次更加疯狂。
到了第七天，从洞穴里面爬出来的时候，浑身虚弱无力，身上也觉得寒冷，因为身上的能量又再次消耗得干干净净了，于是阳顶天从耳朵里面挖出唯一的一颗火焰药丸吃了下去。
顿时，一股热量猛地从体内炸开，流淌在全身筋脉，暖洋洋的有着说不出来的舒服，一股浑厚的力量也渐渐散发出来，阳顶天仿佛觉得自己的四肢变得粗壮有力起来。
借着这股能量，阳顶天逼着眼睛疯狂地朝着东边奔跑。
奔跑，奔跑，奔跑……
在两个太阳的照射下，在一片雪白的万里冰雪上，一个黑点飞快地移动。
这一次，老天眷顾阳顶天，差不多足足晴了九天。其实第五日天开始阴沉，阳顶天还担心会下大雪，结果只下了不到三个小时，乌云又散去。
这九天，阳顶天跑出了三千多里。还有一千里左右，就可以跑出这该死的万里冰川了。
就在他要一鼓作气跑完这一千多里的时候，天公不作美，阳顶天遇到有史以来最强的狂风暴雪，几乎直接将他吹飞出去。阳顶天不得不再挖一个洞穴深深躲起来。

好在这次风雪来得无比凶猛取得还算比较快，两天后冰雪停止，天色放晴。但是从洞穴爬出来之后，阳顶天体内的能量已经所剩无几，剩下一千多里要完全靠意志力了。
四天后，阳顶天跑了一千里，但火焰药丸的能量已经完全耗尽。阳顶天没有任何吃的东西，只能吃冰雪，身体一天天地虚弱，由跑变成走，最后身体完全麻木，眼睛也渐渐看不到东西，只要一躺下就绝对再也站不起来。
就在他要完全崩溃倒下的时候，他看到了第一棵大树，冲上云霄的苍天大树。
他顿时喜极而泣，涌起最后的力气仰天长啸。
“啊……”
足足一个月了，他终于跑完五千七百多里，离开了这该死的万里冰川。他的视野内终于出现了不是白色的东西了。
他终于吃到了东西，尽管超级难吃，又苦又涩的树籽，但他还是吃了几十颗，吃到整个舌头和嘴巴都完全麻木了。
吃饱后，美美睡了一觉，起来后阳顶天继续往东边走。越往东边，树木越多越密集，到最后完全是茂密的大森林。大森林里面都是超级大树，每一个都间距几十米，所以在大森林间并不难走。

content_en:
Although he has only passed the enlightenment stage in this world, because he has washed his marrow and cut his veins to the third level, his body feels as if there is a wind flowing freely. If he were on Earth, he would have broken all world records long ago.
Two hours later, Yang Dingtian had traveled nearly a hundred miles. Of course, he can actually run faster, but the faster he runs, the energy in his body is consumed quickly, so he must master a balance.
More than ten hours later, Yang Dingtian had run more than five hundred miles without feeling tired at all. The martial arts in this world were so powerful. Yang Dingtian had just passed the enlightenment period and was able to run more than five hundred miles a day without getting tired. Of course, he didn't know that the biggest contribution was the third level of marrow cleansing and vein cutting.
But more than ten hours later, heavy snow fell and strong winds blew, blowing in the opposite direction to Yang Dingtian, making it difficult for him to move, and the energy consumption was extremely accelerated, so he had to dig a cave in the snow to hide and wait for the wind and snow to pass.
This hiding lasted three full days.
Three days later, the weather cleared up, and the sky was blue as if washed by water. The two suns shone brightly on the earth like bright gems, reflecting on the white snow and making it almost impossible to open one's eyes.
Yang Dingtian came out of the deep snow. Fortunately, he was of Nine Suns, otherwise he would have been buried under more than ten meters of snow and suffocated to death.
It is strange to say that after cleansing the marrow and cutting off the pulse, Yang Dingtian needed a lot less oxygen to breathe. He could hold his breath for nearly twenty minutes, and a small amount of oxygen could allow him to survive for a long time.
After finally waiting until the sky cleared, Yang Dingtian quickly ran towards the east, and he ran with his eyes closed, because the white snow here was too dazzling, and here Wanli thought of the snowfield without worrying about running into anything.
Yang Dingtian was lucky, it was sunny for three days this time.
In these three days, Yang Dingtian ran more than a thousand miles. But three days later, the strong wind came again, so Yang Dingtian had to dig a cave to hide again.
I hid for seven days, and the wind and snow this time were even crazier than the last time.
On the seventh day, when he crawled out of the cave, he felt weak and cold because the energy in his body was completely exhausted again, so Yang Dingtian dug out the only flame pill from his ear and ate it.
Suddenly, a burst of heat suddenly exploded from the body, flowing through the muscles and veins of the whole body. The warmth was indescribably comfortable, and a strong force gradually emitted. Yang Dingtian seemed to feel that his limbs had become thicker and stronger.
With this energy, Yang Dingtian forced his eyes to run wildly towards the east.
Run, run, run...
Under the illumination of two suns, a black dot moved rapidly on a vast expanse of white ice and snow.
This time, God favored the sky and it was sunny for almost nine days. In fact, the sky started to get gloomy on the fifth day, and Yang Dingtian was still worried that it would snow heavily. However, it only snowed for less than three hours, and the dark clouds dispersed again.
In these nine days, Yang Dingtian traveled more than three thousand miles. There are still about a thousand miles before we can run out of this damn Wanli Glacier.
Just when he was about to run more than a thousand miles in one go, the gods were unfavorable. Yang Dingtian encountered the strongest snowstorm in history, which almost blew him away. Yang Dingtian had to dig another deep cave to hide.
Fortunately, this time the snowstorm came very violently and was achieved relatively quickly. After two days, the snow and ice stopped and the sky cleared up. But after crawling out of the cave, Yang Dingtian had very little energy left in his body, and he had to rely entirely on willpower for the remaining more than a thousand miles.
Four days later, Yang Dingtian ran a thousand miles, but the energy of the flame pill had been completely exhausted. Yang Dingtian had nothing to eat and could only eat ice and snow. His body became weaker day by day and he changed from running to walking. In the end, his body was completely numb and his eyes were completely numb.My eyes gradually became blind, and once I lay down, I would never stand up again.
Just when he was about to collapse completely, he saw the first big tree, a big tree rising into the sky.
He suddenly burst into tears of joy, summoning up the last of his strength to shout to the sky.
"Ah..."
After a full month, he finally ran more than 5,700 miles and left this damn thousand-mile glacier. Finally something that wasn't white appeared in his field of vision.
He finally ate something. Although the seeds were super unpleasant, bitter and astringent, he still ate dozens of them until his tongue and mouth were completely numb.
After eating, Meimei took a good nap, and when she got up, Yang Dingtian continued walking eastward. The further east you go, the more trees become denser and denser, until it is completely a dense forest. There are super big trees in the big forest, each one is tens of meters apart, so it is not difficult to walk between the big forests.
